summary: Review schema and data migrations for reversibility, partial failure, compatibility and rehearsal evidence.

must_inspect.why: Rolling deploys can run old and new code against transitional schema states.
false_positive_guards: A coordinated stop-the-world deploy may intentionally use a narrower compatibility window.

must_inspect.why: Backfills and DDL can succeed partially and require deterministic resume or repair.
false_positive_guards: Transactional DDL behavior differs by database; do not assume support.

must_inspect.why: A rollback script is not proof of recoverability unless data-loss semantics and rehearsal are understood.
false_positive_guards: Irreversible migrations can be acceptable with tested restore or forward-fix strategy.
Do not claim a rollback works merely because a file exists.
